text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, normocytic anemia, thrombocytopenia, mild hypoalbuminemia, and hypoproteinemia. There is leukopenia with lymphopenia, neutropenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and increased red cell distribution width. These findings may suggest bone marrow dysfunction or infiltration, possible chronic disease, or acute infection. Further clinical correlation and additional diagnostic workup are recommended.
